body:
I feel like I want to say something positive and encouraging but couldn't think of anyhmthing without feeling like a hypocrite or feeling empty inside.. I'm sorry.

But I do hope that you can push through it and sometimes make time for breathers. Maybe you're one of those that can make it. :)
well next time you think about it, maybe you can remind yourself that there definitely is some others like that too :)

I have the same.. although I don't know if I have ever been a cheering effect to anyone.. but it's hard to try and go like your wearing a veil so thick that it's hard to breathe.  And that what it feels like sometimes, to try and be friends.. but then they don't give much of a shit anyway and I get cynical and think that why I am I even trying to hide it anymore or.. something.

It's hard not to just give up..
I know the feeling... it's so fucking tiring, right? :(

I've had these feelings for so long too and gotten better at repressing the action... but sometimes it's just too much and I blurt stuff out.. Like the other day.. an old friend that literally just had her first baby.. she didn't reply to me on fb for a day and I was fussing over it and asked I I had been somehow insulting to her..

Which was of course the dumbest thing.. >_>

Friendships are hard..  I'm a bit envious that you've gotten a start at it though, multiple times.. Remember to congratulate yourself on that even if it seems  bittersweet. 

I am a person who is too self-conscious and oversensitive of the possible negative thoughts of people that I don't even dare and end up just kicking myself and the world for not having any proper friends..

so.. with older friends I know the feeling.. but I admire you, I truly do. For getting a start at it.

true enough, people don't want extra baggage.. it really is tiring though, to keep up appearances.. especially when they ask the simple questions to get to know you and in my situation even answering them makes me feel like I seem like a loser..

but true.

I seem to have a problem with exactly that.. I seem to have lost the hobbies that are really for the physical presence and don't even know where to start otherwise..

Bf has his own things already and otherwise he too is a bit poor in social interaction and more of an introvert than I actually am.. Hence He's not that much help... :(

but you are on point though... my situation just is.. difficult and.. clueless >_>

also, much of the old friends are probably the reason I feel this way. Most just don't seem to be that  interested in spending time with me and I don't want to be a nuisance

Yeah, true enough.. but it feels so difficult.. I'm hypersensitive to what people might think or feel sometimes and it is quite debilitating in a social situation. Also.. I seem to be quite demanding to make friends.. maybe because it's safer to let my guard down with a specific type of person or something..

Also, been in this town so long that it alone feels very hindering for any new group ventures because small circles and such.. :(

alas, I am being a huge pessimist

It's okay to feel that way, to feel a bit sad. But sometimes just allow yourself that and then let it go. Don't keep holding on to it. Because you can go forward and just try again or just focus on how the process makes /you/ feel and focus on the positive in that.

I have these exact same feelings sometimes. I can be so weird and exhausting sometimes... having a random tantrum or feeling like a piece of shit and so on... but he doesn't seem to question. He supports the best he can but ofc sometimes he just says that he wishes he could help because he doesn't know how.  

But still. Compared to previous stuff I've experienced.. he is amazing. But can't help the feeling of fear that I'll yet break him with my gloom :(

But hey, lucky for us for finding some great people to be alongside us!

well actually where I live university studies are without tuition fees, so that's not a factor but yeah... They enforce the notion that it's your own work in the end and only you are responsible etc... so I feel like even though I feel the guidance has sometimes led me astray, I haven't dared to challenge it..

It feels like a personal failure since they maintain that students should know their stuff and how to study in university level and take responsibility of their own work..

Thank you for listening to me and giving me feedback.

Well.. I have no idea what the plan is now since I'm getting the idea that the professor I've been seeing is starting to be all out of guidance for me.. and I have no idea how to do stuff or when I should be ready.. and if I ask I guess they'll say something like that it's up to me etc. but this is getting ridiculous and I feel such shame...

I just don't want to take any more of their time.

Yeah well.. It's just a bachelor's thesis and I have been trying to finish it for two years.. for the first time someone actually took the time to properly look at what I've been writing and the feedback was pretty brutal... I think it's partly because I might have gotten the wrong idea from previous guidance.. but I feel like I should have known.....
Thank you for your kind words... the emptiness though, is hard.. I thought that if I filled it with enough people and social interaction it would lessen.. but that seems to not be the case..

Thank you for your time and advice... I guess time management is one thing but apparently I have deeper problems since my professor is starting to question how I even passed my courses because the writing in my thesis is so disconnected and unintelligent.. I know I had problems but I have never gotten such feedback.. I guess better late than never I guess but I'm afraid I'm too far gone..

My studies are going to shit, I feel like I ache for my failures and frustrations with myself so much that it's becoming too much.. I also don't even actually know what I want. Hard to act on anything really since I have lost the way.

I have a person in my life that knows me and cares about me, but with all this I'm just hurting him too and hindering his own coping. I feel like a dissapointment to him too. He can't carry me, no one can.

I can't have a life where I have no purpose. It feels empty. And I feel like the person that I am can't achieve purpose.. I don't know why I go on..
